comment: Skipped on rri-mtest: RRI does not show a domain's authInfo (it holds only its hash), so the case cannot read it back.
description: authInfo is 0-1: a PATCH may remove it (RFC 5731 domain:null).

setup.comment: Creates contact R61 with authInfo (by backend); expects 201. The registrant of the domain below. Only where a domain needs a registrant (rri-mtest).
Creates domain gu61 with authInfo, registrant R61 (by backend), dns records a (by backend); expects 201. The domain the steps below work on.

steps.comment: Patches domain gu61: remove /authInfo; expects 200. The operation this case checks.

teardown.comment: Deletes domain gu61; expects 200. MTEST keeps what a case creates, so the case deletes it.
